scope: EVALUATOR ONLY. Never load or transmit this file during inference.
image_resolution: Resolve images only through pilot.json relative to its directory. Join catalog entries by ID and verify input_sha256; ignore catalog.image, including its historical /course paths.

score_groups.controlled: Known generated ink centerlines, including intentional wobble; never substitute ideal_function.
score_groups.paper-style: Approximate visual references, not independently verified. Report annotation uncertainty and exploratory metrics separately.
score_groups.real: Approximate visual references and, for some cases, arbitrary normalized axes. Report exploratory pixel metrics separately.

cases.review_focus: Visible smooth curve and coordinates; compare to the actual centerline.
Retain the visible sharp corner as an actual polyline vertex.
Preserve two disconnected branches without a connecting segment.
Preserve photographed ink and label conflicts. The intended generation equation is not ground truth.
Preserve partial/curved/flat sections. The reference's normalized axes are not numeric-scale ground truth.

Inspect isolated point output, any invented connections, and uncertainty/assistance. Do not treat legacy reference_branch_count=0 or branches=[] as verified absence. No point locations/counts have been independently annotated.

qualitative_review.unverified_judgments: Leave preservation/invention unverified pending photo review; record point counts, curve counts, and clarification requests independently.
